summary: Marksmanship 7/39/5 with a 1.0 sec cat, taking Efficiency 4 and Focused Fire instead of Lone Wolf. The pet deals about 11% of the damage. 44 DPS behind Lone Wolf.
rotation: Pre-pull: Aspect of the Hawk at -3 s, Rapid Fire at -0.1 s
Rapid Fire, racials, potions and Demonic Rune on cooldown
Hunter's Mark (rank 4, +140 ranged attack power) 1.5 s before the pull and again in its last 3 s; the raid's mark is off
Arcane Shot on cooldown (above Aimed Shot, no mana floor)
Aimed Shot on the cooldown it shares with Multi-Shot
Serpent Sting when it is down (after Aimed Shot)
Sniper Shot on cooldown while mana >= 25 x seconds left
Cat (1.0 sec) bites and claws on its own; Auto Shot throughout
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets: 32 Agility and 14 crit rating, and an on-use 415 ranged attack power for 20 s every 2 min (at the pull, then on cooldown).
Assumed fixed onto the rank curve: Trueshot Aura's top rank gives 100 ranged attack power and Hunter's Mark's 140. The client has 50 and 71, below the older ranks' 75 and 98.
Aspect of the Hawk stays at rank 5 (90 RAP) because Forever's rank 6 gives only 55.
Pet scaling: 10% of RAP plus the hunter's hit (SoD placeholder for hit). With SoD's full 22% pet scaling this build would gain 23.
Arcane Shot takes 10% of ranged attack power and Serpent Sting 3% a tick (Forever hunter wiki). The beta log fit was 11% and 3.5%.
Assumed: Auto Shot fires through casts with no 0.5 s aim.
Wildstalker Armor 4-piece and 5-piece aren't in the preset (2-piece only). They would add 13.
Runs short of mana in a 5 minute fight (998.5 DPS at 300 s).
Assumed: 22% more crit per Agility than Classic, the beta's level 1 ratio carried to 60.
Assumed: a pet's hit scales with its attack speed as in Classic. On the beta every pet hits like a 2.0 s pet. The cat is still the best pet, and every cat speed sims within 1 DPS.

The ranged weapon is a 2.5 s bow at Rhok'delar's 44.0 DPS. A 2.6 s gun sims 0.3 to 1.0 higher with a 15% ammo pouch, but 3.4 to 5.2 lower with Era Phase 1's 14% pouch (Ribbly's Bandolier). The 15% quiver takes only arrows.

Hunter's Mark duty: the raid's Hunter's Mark is off and the hunter keeps its own up. The first cast is 1.5 s before the pull, then one GCD and 60 mana every 2 min. Costs 1.4 / 1.4 / 1.5 DPS at 120 / 180 / 300 s against Marksmanship.

Windshaper is best (Wind Blessed, 3% haste since client 70425) at every fight length. On Lone Wolf and Marksmanship it is 1.2 to 1.6 ahead of High Order and 5 to 8 ahead of Night Elf. On Beast Mastery it is 0.3 to 0.9 ahead of Human.
